label: a lone smooth anchor drops its trailing move
the pen ignores the stage scale
find: PenRules.add(start, handleOut: end, to: base, scale: scale)
replace: PenRules.add(start, handleOut: end, to: base, scale: 1)

label: a missing out-handle is the in-handle reflected the wrong way (#4012)
find: Point(x: 2 * anchor.point.x - handle.x, y: 2 * anchor.point.y - handle.y)
replace: Point(x: 2 * handle.x - anchor.point.x, y: 2 * handle.y - anchor.point.y)
